content:
**Action Boy** or **Action Girl** depending on the Vault Dweller's gender is an Agility-based perk in *Fallout 76*.

Increases Action Point refresh rate. The art and name of the perk will match the gender of the character.

| Rank | Cost | Description | Form ID | 
| ★★★ | 3 | Action Points regenerate 45% faster. | 0017ED8A | 
| ★★ | 2 | Action Points regenerate 30% faster. | 00065DF5 | 
| ★ | 1 | Action Points regenerate 15% faster. | 0004D869 |
